    Prompt enhancer

    Your selected AI rewrites your request, then receives the improved prompt.

    Send images & videos

    Choose a supported AI chat in your browser.

    Send delivers these files and your message to the selected browser chat. Frames show sampled moments, without audio. Up to 8 attachments / 12 MB per transfer. Codec support depends on your device. Unsupported codecs automatically try your installed FFmpeg decoder (local conversion: up to 64 MB).

    Co-work chat

    Keep chatting with your selected AI. Send follow-ups while your AI works. New requests join your active work at the next safe message boundary. The AI can move between independent tasks while preserving every unfinished goal.

    Appearance
    Make PlazCode look the way you like. Looks are saved on this computer.
    
        
    Color theme
    Themes also color the PlazCode bar in your browser. A custom color colors the PlazCode bar and panels in your browser too.
    
        
    Interface
    FontChoose the type style used across the app.
    Corner radiusHow round the cards and buttons are.
    Border thicknessThe line around cards and panels.
    Border colorFollow the theme color or stay neutral.
    Rainbow borderSlowly cycle card borders through every color.
    Interface gridShow a faint grid behind the pages.
    Pixel modeCrisp pixel-stepped corners and subtle retro scanlines.
    
        
    Background
    WallpaperUse a picture, a GIF, or a short MP4 or WebM video as a wallpaper. It is stored only in this app.
    Wallpaper strengthHow visible the wallpaper is behind the app.
    Panel blurFrosted-glass blur on cards over the picture.
    Panel opacityLower this to see more of the picture through cards.
    Signal rain backdropSubtle ambient code streams behind the workspace. Pauses when hidden or asleep.
    
        
    Glow & gradients
    These two also change the PlazCode bar in your browser.
    Glow effectsSoft light around cards and buttons.
    GradientsColor blends on cards and the sidebar.
    Restore default themeGo back to the original gold theme.
    Appearance
    Choose a shared palette, glow and gradients. Changes also update the PlazCode browser bar and panels while the bridge is connected.

    Settings
    Changes autosave immediately and stay synced with the extension.
    
        
    Language
    Choose the PlazCode interface language. This does not change AI responses, your prompts, code, or tool arguments.
    
        
    
        
    Model
    Manage AI platforms, multi-key rotation, and model health checks.
    
        
    Saved chat logs
    Review or download captured chat logs. Long captures show omitted-message counts; continuation uses bounded summaries and project memory.
    How memory and saved chats work
    Memory notes are short titled notes the AI saves about a project, such as which script handles a system or a decision that was made. Each note has a title so it can be found and reviewed later. Notes can be added, edited or removed above.
    Saved chat logs keep captured messages for review or download. A continuation file carries recent task context into a new chat.
    Notes describe past decisions; the AI still checks current scripts before editing. Neither notes nor chat logs are a game backup.
    

        
    
          
    Execution
    Control where the AI works, when a task pauses, and what happens when Stop is pressed. These settings are shared with the browser extension. Command and time limit changes apply to the next task or when resuming a paused task.
    
            
    Where the AI works
    Pick what PlazCode controls: your Roblox game, or the files and commands in a project folder.
    Roblox Studio edits the open Roblox game through its bridge. AgentScript works with files and commands in the connected project folder. Engine changes apply only to the selected AI tab, not other tabs or browsers.
    
            
    Message size
    Stops very long messages and results from overloading the AI chat.
    Limits are enabled by default and can be changed or switched off. Large tool results are kept in full and delivered in readable pages. The AI can read every page without running the command again. These settings cannot increase an AI website's own limits or set its native answer length.
    Run limits
    Optional. Make PlazCode pause and wait for you if a task runs too long or sends too many commands.
    What do these settings mean?
    Commands per run: the maximum number of AI tool commands before PlazCode pauses, only when Pause at run limits is enabled. Limits are off by default. For example, 20 allows 20 counted commands. Use 0 for no command limit. Internal helper calls do not count.
    Minutes per run: elapsed time allowed for one run. When the time is reached, PlazCode pauses before starting the next command; it does not undo work or interrupt the current command. Use 0 for no time limit.
    Seconds between commands: waits this long before each command result is sent back to the AI. Raise it (for example to 5) if DeepSeek or another site says you are sending too fast. 0 keeps the normal speed.
    Offer to continue previous chat: when on (the default), opening a new chat asks whether to continue where your previous chat left off or start a new project. Turn it off to always start fresh without that prompt. This does not delete saved chats, memory or continuation files.
    Automatic visual review: after a visible Studio change, PlazCode can send a screenshot back to an AI that supports images so it can check the result. At most three images are sent per run, at least 30 seconds apart. This is a visual check, not a guarantee that the game works.
    Continue later
    Pick up where you left off after a pause or in a new chat.
    Save continuation file: downloads a small JSON handoff with the active request, recent chat excerpts and unfinished queued requests. It is not a whole-chat export or a Roblox game backup. To use it, open a fresh supported AI chat, open PlazCode Memory, import it with Load into selected chat, review the context, then ask the AI to continue.
    Resume paused task: continues a task paused by its command or time limit and starts a fresh allowance using the current limits. It does not start a new task when nothing is paused.
    
            
    When you press Stop
    Choose how quickly the AI is cut off.
    Immediate: stop AI generation and stop waiting for tools right away; cancel helper processes that PlazCode owns where possible. Safe: stop AI generation and new commands, then let the current command finish. Neither option undoes edits already made, and some external tools cannot be cancelled.
    
            
    What the AI is allowed to do
    Decide how much freedom the AI has on your computer. Sandbox is the safest.
    Sandbox: AgentScript stays inside the connected project folder. Ask: request approval for writes and command execution. Full: allow AgentScript to work outside the project folder and run PC commands. Roblox actions still use the connected Studio bridge.
    
          
    
          
    Safety
    Limits on what the AI may change. Shared with the browser extension.
    
            
    The AI can look at files, Studio and tools, but can't change anything.
    
            
    PlazCode asks you before the AI deletes files or runs a delete command.
    
            
            
            
    With Full access, files outside the workspace must be in one of these folders. Leave empty to allow the whole PC. Commands can still reach other folders, so use Read-only or Ask mode to control them.
    
            
    
          
    
          
    Luau checks
    After the AI edits a Roblox script, PlazCode checks the new code for mistakes without running it. Only problems the edit added are reported.
    
            
    
            
    
            
    Type problems and warnings are always only reported. Changes apply to the next edit.
    
          
    
          
    Reasoning
    Matches the extension work and thinking controls.
    
            
    
            
    Ask before every edit, only before deletions, or automatically approve task commands.
    
            
    
            
    
            
    
            
    
          
    
          
    Automation
    Existing PlazCode helpers remain unchanged underneath the new UI.

    Debug report
    When something goes wrong, copy a report of recent PlazCode and AI-site errors, warnings and info, with the files involved and the likely cause, then paste it into an AI chat to debug it. Keys, tokens, cookies, user names, e-mail addresses and chat text are removed.
